newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Siderca initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Argentina's Siderca initiated.

text.p: -- Santander Investment initiated Thursday coverage of Argentine steelmaker Siderca with a "buy" recommendation, saying its earnings are expected to soar.
-- "Santander expects earnings per share to jump to $0.17, $0.20 and $0.24 for 1997, 1998 and 1999, respectively, from $0.03 in 1996," it said in a report signed by analyst Andres Biolcati.
-- "The 12- to 18-month target price of $2.55 implies 18 percent upside from the current level."
-- Siderca forms a strategic alliance with Italy's Dalmine, and Tubos de Aceros de Mexico SA (TAMSA).

-- Siderca is one of the world's leading producers of seamless tubes and specializes in the manufacturing of pipes used for drilling, casing and tubing, line pipes, mechanical and high pressure tubes and special joints. It exports 70 percent of its production.
